verdicts.line: [D2] onGrid took decimals from the step's magnitude, so 0.25 rounded 0.75 to 0.8 (scour): fixed 6e0b114823. The fix is in `decimalsOf`, so it also corrects tick labels and the plot editors' grid snapping (xychart and radar `edit.ts`).
[D11] stepTicks returned [] for a negative step (scout): fixed edce4399ce. It now throws a `RangeError`, recorded in `docs/unruled.md`.

[D9] stepTicks had no bound on how many ticks it builds (scour): fixed edce4399ce. It now throws past a `limit` argument that defaults to the new `MAX_TICKS` (1,000,000), and `ticks(count)` holds `count` within that bound. Recorded in `docs/unruled.md`.

[D10] spacedTicks had no cap, and a negative inset was accepted (scour): fixed edce4399ce. It now coarsens its step to stay within `MAX_TICKS` and throws on a negative inset. Recorded in `docs/unruled.md`.
[D4] niceDomain left a single value's far end unrounded (scour): fixed 7f27d5d9a7
[D1] invert divided by the raw range difference, which overflows on a wide range (scour): fixed aafc2b884b. Same fix applied to the power, time, and log scales.
[D5] tickDecimals capped at 20 places (scour): fixed 4a21761e2f. This also drops the log scale's workaround for the old cap.
[D12] timeScale gives a sub-second domain zero or one tick (scour): fixed a848ee6167
[D7] a seconds-unit axis never marks the day it crosses into (scour): fixed 0abb0c2f34
[D6] a narrow log domain places and inverts values with precision error (scour): fixed 866f9ac3b5
[D3] the log scale constructor lists every power just to count to two (scour): fixed 44de74ca5a
